# Ishaq Bhojani — Software Architect · Team Lead

> I design the architecture, then lead the team that ships it. Twelve years, twenty-three products, and a team of five I lead today.

I draw the system first, then lead the team that builds it. Open to lead and architect roles — Karachi, Pakistan. Remote by default, and open to relocating for the right role.

## Case studies

- [An agent desktop where every privileged action is gated](https://ishaq-bhojani.github.io/#/case/agent-desktop): Agent tooling is welded to one vendor and lives inside an IDE or a terminal. Switching to a local model means switching tools — and any app that holds your API key while editing files and running commands is asking for trust it has not earned.
- [An AI job-generation platform, architected from nothing](https://ishaq-bhojani.github.io/#/case/ai-platform): A new AI product with no existing system to build on, needing secure multi-tenant identity and heavy file handling from day one — on a timeline that left no room to rebuild the foundation later.
- [A learning platform carrying two live products](https://ishaq-bhojani.github.io/#/case/learning-platform): An LMS and an on-demand services app both had to run as real products, with search, media and notifications that could not block a user request — built by a team spread across several time zones.
- [One monolith, split into modules teams could ship alone](https://ishaq-bhojani.github.io/#/case/micro-frontend): A high-traffic e-commerce front end where every change — however small — meant redeploying the entire application, and every team waited on every other team to be ready.

## Products

- [Modelith](https://github.com/ishaq-bhojani/Modelith) (LIVE): Open-source AI agent desktop, any provider, every action gated
- LogiTrax (IN BUILD): Fleet tracking on commercial GPS hardware, with Urdu/RTL support
- DHA City Medical Center (IN BUILD): Hospital management: registration, pharmacy, batch inventory
- Athleon Arena (IN BUILD): Sports venue booking, payments and event-sourced live scoring

- Chelooms (IN BUILD): Marketplace platform, under wraps until launch
- PlanKaro (IN BUILD): Consumer discovery app, under wraps until launch
- Shikaku (COMING SOON): Offline logic-puzzle game, minimalist by design
- Arrows (COMING SOON): Puzzle escape game, three mechanics prototyped
- AO Skills (LIVE): AI-based job generation, front end and back end
- AO LMS (LIVE): Learning management system, front end and back end
- ECOM MFE (LIVE): Micro-frontend modules for an e-commerce site
- PMO Tracker (LIVE): Jira/Trello-like project and resource management
- NPM Project Check (LIVE): Plugin validating dependencies against a config
- UI Template Generator (LIVE): Generates whole projects from user input
- Recommendations Admin (LIVE): Admin panel configuring an ML server
- Customer Admin (LIVE): Admin panel for call-centre users
- Le Bijou (LIVE): Automated hotel and booking management
- Matterz (LIVE): Property lawyers managing clients, deals, escrow
- Team Reporter (LIVE): Employers viewing activity, distributing instructions
- Islamic Mode (LIVE): Religious activity app, iOS and Android
- Daily Momin (LIVE): Checklist app for tracking religious activities
